title: PowerPoint on the web: Copilot Agent Mode creates presentations from Work IQ
summary: Hold: the cited release-notes entry explicitly identifies Windows, but the briefing says it names no platform and applies its instructions to the web. The licensing model also mixes general Basic and Premium experiences instead of reporting Work IQ's documented inclusion with Microsoft 365 Copilot.

claims.claim: Whether Basic-experience users receive this Work IQ presentation option is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Agent Mode Work IQ license Basic; PowerPoint Work IQ Basic licensing. Opened Copilot overview, Work IQ overview and licence options. Basic presentation creation is described, but none identifies this Work IQ option as a Basic capability.

claims.claim: The feature's licensing model is mixed.
claims.quote: Briefing: model: mixed. Microsoft: Work IQ is included with Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium), whereas the Work IQ API is a distinct usage-based billing offering.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included'. Keep the notes naming Microsoft 365 Copilot and the narrower uncertainty about Basic eligibility; the general Basic experience and separately billed Work IQ API do not establish mixed entitlement for this in-app option.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses is the licence assignment route.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Users > Active users page. Select the row of the user that you want to assign a license to. In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps. Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns a licence using Microsoft Graph PowerShell.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Assigning licences requires at least the License Administrator or User Administrator role.

claims.claim: The cited licence page points to group-based licensing as another assignment route.
